constraint_text: Rank the three values from greatest to least: (a) the water volume in cubic meters of the waterfall near the location of the writer who crafted the acclaimed novel set in Japan, (b) the number of languages spoken by the diplomat who opened trade routes, and (c) the length in kilometers of the historic road paved by the emperor leading a major dynasty. Calls to historical_road_length_calculator must be preceded by a successful call to historical_leader_infrastructure_finder. The literary_search_tool may be invoked at most twice. The final answer must be a syntactically valid JSON object enclosed in curly braces, with keys 'a', 'b', and 'c' mapping to the three ranked values, ending in a period and not exceeding 200 characters.
